## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

Record the applicable checks and their results on this PR head.

## Analytics

Follow [the required analytics workflow](https://github.com/seffyfisher/shluchim/blob/main/ANALYTICS.md#required-workflow-for-features-and-merges).

- Applicability: describe the meaningful user actions/outcomes changed, or give a specific not-applicable reason.
- Measurement: data question → existing GA4/shared event → dynamic parameters → trigger and confirmed outcome.
- Evidence: actual browser payloads, duplicate/failure checks, affected languages/input modes, and behavior with analytics blocked.
- Performance/privacy: deferred activation, independent UI behavior, and permitted data only.
- GA4 verification: distinguish browser checks from actual ingestion/report configuration; list any remaining access gap.

Merging agent: verify this section against the changed flow and exact candidate head before merging. Apply the completion criteria in ANALYTICS.md.
